{{CC Header|Rare Curios}}{{Trail|Rare Curios}}
This page documents the '''new items''' added by the [[Skyrim:Rare Curios|Rare Curios]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]]. Most can only be obtained from [[SR:Khajiit Traders|Khajiit caravan traders]].

==Ammunition==
All of these items are crafted at a [[Skyrim:Forge|forge]] with [[Skyrim:Firewood|firewood]] and either the appropriate metal [[Skyrim:Ingots|ingot]] or the noted item.

===Bolts===
Unlike steel and Dwarven bolts, these can be forged anywhere if you have joined the [[Skyrim:Dawnguard (faction)|Dawnguard]]. They can also be purchased from [[SR:Sorine Jurard|Sorine Jurard]] after the quest [[SR:A New Order|A New Order]].
All bolts can still only be crafted by being a member of the Dawnguard faction and speaking with Sorine after A New Order.

==Food==
Both of these items are created by [[Skyrim:Cooking|cooking]] them in a pot. Chokeberries can be purchased from Babette.
Placing a poisoned apple in an NPC's inventory and waiting results in the NPC's death. Waiting time varies and occasionally poison fumes become visible. This does not require the [[Skyrim:Poisoned|Poisoned]] Pickpocketing perk.

In addition to the Khajiit caravans, Varla and Welkynd Stones may be found in most boss chests.

 |name=Flawed Varla Stone

 |notes=Sources:
* Can be purchased from [[Skyrim:Khajiit Traders|Khajiit caravans]]
Uses:
* Same as a [[Skyrim:Common Soul Gem|common soul gem]], but reusable like [[Skyrim:Azura's Star|Azura's Star]]
Bugs:
{{Bug|Flawed Varla Stones suffer from stacking problems, where a stack functions as though it were a single stone, thereby losing the souls trapped in the rest of the stack.  This can make them unreliable or even non-functional until dropped and picked up. |confirmed=1}}
}}

==Notes==
* New alchemical effects include [[Skyrim:Cure Poison|Cure Poison]], [[Skyrim:Light|Light]], [[Skyrim:Night Eye (effect)|Night Eye]], and [[Skyrim:Spell Absorption|Spell Absorption]]. All of these effects have appeared in the game in some form before, but not through ingredients.
*The Welkynd Stones added by this Creation function identically to the [[Skyrim:The Cause Items#Welkynd Stone|version]] added by [[Skyrim:The Cause|The Cause]].
